scenario_narratives.base: Execution risk, not impairment. Alibaba is spending the FY2026-FY2028 cash flow of the marketplace -- and, since 26 Aug 2026, RMB ~68bn of fresh equity -- on AI compute (capex ~23% of revenue in FY2027, RMB ~257bn) and on the last leg of the quick-commerce subsidy war, so owner FCF is negative in FY2027-FY2029 and only turns in FY2030. The axes that decide the case: (1) whether AI Cloud and Compute Services keeps compounding at 30-45% with EBITA margin rising from ~12% (Q1 FY2027: revenue +45%, EBITA +133%); (2) whether capex intensity actually falls after FY2028 -- the equity raise says the peak is being funded externally, not that it is over; (3) whether Taobao Instant Commerce reaches unit-economics breakeven by end-FY2027 as guided (Q1 showed sequential improvement at stable share) while the SAMR anti-subsidy rules hold; (4) whether AI Labs/Qwen consumer losses (RMB13.9bn in one quarter) are capped rather than open-ended; (5) core CMR stays roughly flat (-7% reported / +1% like-for-like) rather than resuming share loss to PDD and Douyin. The EU DSA fine (EUR550M, booked in Q1 FY2027 G&A) and the DoD 1260H litigation are carried in the discount rate, not the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: Cloud is now a margin story as well as a growth story: 45% growth with EBITA margin doubling, Apple Intelligence embedding Qwen in the China iPhone base, Qwen3-Max-Thinking keeping Alibaba at the frontier, AI-related product revenue (RMB12.4bn in Q1, twelfth straight triple-digit quarter) approaching a $10bn run-rate, and the $100bn five-year external cloud+AI target on track. The same absolute capex is spread over faster revenue, so intensity normalises by FY2030; quick commerce turns profitable in FY2027 and e-commerce CMR re-accelerates on AI-driven merchant tools. Mature EBITDA margin 25%, terminal FCF margin ~12%; the 15x FCF cap binds, so the bull does not rely on a terminal multiple the market has not paid.
scenario_narratives.bear: The capex supercycle does not pay: management keeps spending through FY2028 (RMB ~520bn over two years, part of it the August 2026 equity) into a price-competitive China AI market (DeepSeek, ByteDance, Huawei), cloud growth decelerates below 25%, AI Labs keeps burning, and the capex is cut only after the returns disappoint. Quick-commerce breakeven slips as Meituan re-engages; CMR resumes low-single-digit decline. On the regulatory axis the EU judges AliExpress remediation inadequate and levies follow-on DSA penalties, and the DoD designation survives the Northern District of California challenge, keeping US institutions out. Owner FCF stays negative until FY2031 and the business is worth little more than its balance sheet (pro-forma net cash + investments ~HK$27/share of the ~HK$48 bear value).

valuation_philosophy.summary: FY2026-FY2029 are investment-trough years by choice, not demand decline. This build models the capex supercycle explicitly as a component owner-FCF path with negative FCF through FY2029 and the recovery pushed to FY2030, discounted at a single RMB-built 10% WACC that carries a regulatory/litigation premium for the EU DSA exposure and the DoD designation. Versus this morning's version the anchors move to the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet (net cash down RMB53bn in the quarter) and the 26 Aug 2026 placing (710M shares, RMB ~68bn), with the Q1 burn charged once via a stub add-back and the July dividend deducted; FY2027-28 capex intensity is 1pp higher and SBC is held at a 1.3% plateau. Terminal value is Gordon-bound in base (implied ~6x EV/EBITDA, below the FY2022-25 normal-year 8.1x average), so no multiple expansion is assumed; the strategic investment portfolio (Ant etc.) enters the bridge at half book and NCI is deducted. The placing is the fact that matters most for how to read the stock: a company that was the market's largest buyer of its own shares in FY2024-25 is now a net issuer, at a price near the bottom of its 52-week range, to fund compute. That is reflected in the share count and cash, and in the capex path -- not in the weights, which were already moved toward the bear this morning.
key_risks_to_valuation: Capex intensity: every 1pp of FY2027-FY2031 capex/revenue that does not normalise is ~RMB 60-70bn of cumulative owner FCF; the base assumes intensity halves from 23% to 11% by FY2032. The placing shows the company is willing to fund overshoot with equity, which dilutes rather than merely burns.
Cloud deceleration below 30% before margin matures would break the base margin path (22% mature EBITDA).
EU DSA follow-on penalties (up to 6% of global turnover) and a DoD 1260H loss are in the discount rate (1.25pp), not the flows; a realised penalty of that size would be a flow event.
Investment-portfolio bridge (~HK$13.3/share at 50% of book) depends on Ant Group's realisable value and PRC exit taxes; strike it and the weighted IV falls by that amount.
RMB/HKD: every 1% move in CNYHKD moves every HKD value 1%; fx_rate is dated 2026-10-22 and is not refreshed by refresh_price.py. The placing proceeds are also converted at that rate.
Further equity issuance: a second placing of similar size at a price below IV would be dilutive; the model assumes the count is flat at 20,034M from here.
Mainland Southbound flows are a 9988.HK-specific demand source that can move the HK price away from the ADS parity line for extended periods; the valuation ignores it.

inputs.placing_treatment: Equity placing completed 2026-08-26: 710,000,000 new ordinary shares at HK$112.70, gross ~HK$80.0bn, stated net proceeds HK$47,871M + HK$31,914M = HK$79,785M, use of proceeds AI compute / data centres (6-K filed 2026-08-26, accession 0001193125-26-365894). Treatment: the 710M shares are ADDED to the share count (19,324 -> 20,034M) and the net proceeds are ADDED to cash (RMB67,902M at CNYHKD 1.175) in inputs.cash / net_debt. The capex the proceeds fund is ALREADY in the projection (FY2027 capex 23% of revenue, RMB ~257bn; FY2028 21%), so the proceeds are NOT also netted against projected capex -- counting the cash and reducing the capex would double-count. The placing is slightly accretive to IV per share (issued above the model's weighted IV) and is shown as its own reconciliation line. It is also evidence: raising ~RMB68bn of equity at a 52-week-low-area price, with RMB208bn of net cash still on hand, says management expects the compute spend to run beyond internal cash generation through FY2028, which is why FY2027-28 capex intensity is nudged up 1pp (see assumptions.base.capex_rationale).
inputs.wacc_rationale: UNCHANGED from this morning's build; nothing in the Q1 release or the placing moves the discount rate. Built in the flows' own currency (RMB), single rate across scenarios (risk lives in the flows and weights, charged once). Cost of equity 10.6% = China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.1 x China ERP 5.5% (7.85%) + 1.5% VIE/Cayman-structure and PRC platform-regulation premium + 0.5% US geopolitical/DoD 1260H overhang + 0.75% EU DSA and litigation premium. Debt ~13% of capital at ~2.1% after tax gives 9.5%; rounded UP to 10.0% because the marginal 9988.HK holder (Southbound and international funds) prices off a higher risk-free than onshore CGB. Would move on: a DSA follow-on penalty actually levied (into the flows, premium out), or a DoD 1260H ruling either way.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases are expensed inside adjusted EBITDA (US GAAP ASC 842 operating-lease cost in opex); lease liabilities are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt. Finance leases are immaterial. One treatment, consistently applied.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; noncontrolling interests (RMB57,272M) and mezzanine equity (RMB7,584M) at 30 Jun 2026 book are deducted once in the equity bridge. Not folded into the tax rate as well.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: marketplace + cloud), unchanged from this morning's 2026-10-22 build; 10-year horizon FY2027-FY2036 because the owner-FCF margin is still ramping through FY2031. UPDATE scope: (1) anchors refreshed to the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet and the 26 Aug 2026 placing (net cash, debt, share count, dividend payable, Q1 stub add-back, NCI/mezzanine, investment portfolio); (2) drivers re-judged against the Q1 FY2027 release -- FY2027 revenue growth 9% CONFIRMED (Q1 +9%, cloud +45%, quick commerce +45%, CMR -7% reported / +1% like-for-like); FY2027 EBITDA margin 13.5% UNCHANGED (Q1 adjusted EBITDA 39,143 = 14.6%, AI Labs -13.9bn/qtr, E-commerce Group EBITA flat YoY, quarter-by-quarter build brackets 12-14% for the year); FY2027 D&A 5.5% UNCHANGED (Q1 12,479 = 4.6% but PP&E +RMB30bn in the quarter); FY2027-28 capex RAISED 1pp (22/20 -> 23/21 base, 21/18 -> 22/19 bull, 23/21 -> 24/22 bear) on the Q1 run-rate (67,660 = 25% of revenue, +75% YoY) and the equity raise earmarked for compute; SBC% LOWERED to a 1.3% plateau (Q1 run-rate 1.23%, third consecutive year of decline) -- the only change beyond FY2027-28, made because the prior path rose from 1.5% to 1.45% in FY2029, which the trend does not support. FY2029+ growth, margins, D&A, capex, tax, WACC, terminal growth, caps and weights are deliberately UNCHANGED; what would move them is listed in assumptions.*.unchanged_note. Matching-asset rule: interest income and investment income/share of Ant results are outside the flows, so cash-like assets sit in net_debt and the strategic investment portfolio sits in equity_bridge (at 50% of book). Charge-once rules: SBC expensed + flat count (placing added once, explicitly); NCI deducted in the bridge only; leases in opex only; single WACC; Q1 burn in the balance sheet OR in the flows, not both (stub add-back). Terminal value = max(0, min(Gordon, cap x FCF_N)) on FCF. All RMB-level assumptions are listing-venue-agnostic and should be mirrored into BABA_DCF.json at its next refresh.

bear.rationale: AI capex ROI disappoints: FY2027-28 spend proceeds as committed and now equity-funded (24%/22% of revenue, moved with the base by 1pp) but is then cut hard because it does not earn its return, so capex reverts to the 8% pre-AI-plus-cloud norm by FY2034 while revenue growth never exceeds 6% and the EBITDA margin recovers only to 17% (quick-commerce breakeven slips; AI Labs losses persist; EU DSA follow-on penalties and compliance cost weigh on international). SBC path mirrors base. Everything else unchanged. Owner FCF stays negative through FY2030. The 12x FCF cap binds marginally (Gordon at 10%/2% would be 12.75x). Terminal PV exceeds EV because the explicit years are net cash-consuming.

base.growth_rationale: UNCHANGED. FY2027 +9% is now confirmed against the extracted Q1 FY2027 release (+9% YoY: AI Cloud and Compute 48,437 +45%, China Quick Commerce 53,295 +45%, China E-commerce 110,900 -8% with CMR -7% reported / +1% like-for-like after the contra-revenue subsidy programme, International -1%, Global Wholesale +7%). Cloud and quick commerce together add ~RMB30bn/quarter YoY, i.e. ~12pp of group growth, against ~-4pp from China E-commerce. Decelerates to 4% by FY2036 as cloud growth normalises; 10-yr CAGR 6.9%.
base.margin_rationale: UNCHANGED at 13.5% for FY2027. Q1 FY2027 adjusted EBITDA 39,143 = 14.6% of revenue (release line 223; adjusted EBITA 27,329 = 10.2%). Segment EBITA: E-commerce Group 39,749 (flat YoY despite quick commerce), Cloud 5,628 (+133%, 11.6% margin), AI Labs -13,861, All others -3,343. A quarter-by-quarter build for FY2027 -- Q2 laps the peak-subsidy Q2 FY2026 (group adjusted EBITA 9,073), Q3 carries 11.11, AI Labs losses held at ~-14-15bn/quarter -- brackets 12-14% for the year, so 13.5% stands. Recovers as quick commerce reaches unit-economics breakeven (guided end-FY2027; Q1 showed sequential improvement in AOV and fulfilment cost while holding share) and cloud scales; matures at 22%.
base.capex_rationale: RAISED FY2027 22% -> 23% and FY2028 20% -> 21%; FY2029+ unchanged. Q1 FY2027 capex RMB67,660M (release line 1150; 25.2% of quarterly revenue, +75% YoY, a new high) annualises to ~RMB270bn; management attributes part of the step-up to procurement-cycle timing and chip pricing, so the full year is set below the run-rate at ~RMB257bn (23%). The 26 Aug 2026 placing of ~RMB68bn earmarked for AI compute and data centres, done with RMB208bn of net cash on hand, is read as management expecting spend beyond internal generation through FY2028, hence the FY2028 nudge; the RMB380bn three-year plan is already exceeded by FY2027. Intensity then normalises to 9.5% by FY2035 as before -- above the 5-6% pre-AI norm because cloud is a larger share of revenue. D&A lags capex and peaks at 10% of revenue in FY2030-31. Owner FCF turns positive in FY2030.
base.sbc_rationale: LOWERED to a 1.3% plateau (prior 1.5/1.5/1.45/1.4/1.4/1.35/1.3/1.3/1.25/1.25). Q1 FY2027 total SBC 3,304 = 1.23% of revenue, -7% YoY, after 18,546 -> 15,577 -> 14,821 in FY2024-26; the prior path started above the FY2026 actual (1.45%) and would have had SBC rising as a share of revenue into FY2029, which three years of decline do not support. Held at 1.3% (above the Q1 run-rate, allowing for the AI-talent grants management flags) and trimmed to 1.25% only from FY2035.
base.tax_rationale: UNCHANGED. 18% cash rate on EBIT: 15% HNTE rate on the core PRC subsidiaries, 25% standard elsewhere, plus withholding on repatriation; FY2025 income tax 35.4bn on ~165bn pre-tax = 21% including investment-gain taxes. Same in all scenarios.
base.unchanged_note: FY2029-FY2036 growth, margin, D&A and capex paths, the 18% tax rate, 10% WACC, 3% terminal growth and the 15x FCF cap are carried from this morning's build without re-derivation. Evidence that would move them: cloud growth decelerating below 30% before segment EBITA margin passes 15% (margin path down); a stated FY2028 capex number from management (capex path either way); quick-commerce breakeven slipping past FY2028 (FY2028-29 margin down); a DSA follow-on penalty or DoD ruling (WACC premium into/out of the flows).

bull.rationale: Same absolute RMB capex as base in FY2027-28 (so intensity 22%/19% on the faster revenue line, moved with the base by 1pp) spread over faster revenue -- cloud sustains 40%+ through FY2029 on Apple Intelligence distribution and the $100bn five-year external cloud+AI target -- so intensity falls faster; cloud mix lifts the mature EBITDA margin to 25%. SBC path mirrors base. Everything else unchanged from this morning's build. The 15x FCF cap binds (Gordon at 10%/3.5% would be 15.9x).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: UNCHANGED at 30/50/20 (set this morning, from 25/50/25 in July). The extracted Q1 release confirms rather than adds to the evidence that moved them: capex +75% YoY, AI Labs losses quadrupled, buybacks cut ~80%, EU DSA fine booked, DoD litigation unresolved. The placing is neutral on weights -- it removes any liquidity angle from the bear (RMB208bn net cash before proceeds, RMB276bn after) but confirms the spend will run beyond internal generation, which is the bear's premise. Base 50%: gradual normalisation from FY2030, supported by the Q1 cloud margin inflection and continued subsidy de-escalation. Bull 20%: needs sustained 40%+ cloud growth, capex intensity falling from FY2029, quick-commerce breakeven on schedule, no further EU penalties and a DoD win, all at once.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
